window_and_guard_policy.policy: A resident field's spatial window covers 1.5x the camera viewport, so a covered camera move reuses the resident field. The refill guard is the viewport expanded by 1.25x; the re-centring trigger fires when the resident field stops covering the guard, which is before the camera's own demand leaves the resident window.

store_budget_rederivation.kind: declared cap, not a measured optimum
store_budget_rederivation.history: The ceiling was raised from 32 MiB to the decoded-band ceiling of 128 MiB during the precursor experiment (8370945), so it was never derived from a residency requirement.

resident_time_window_case.note: The resident time window adds members over the same spatial window rather than replacing fields.

other_declared_budgets.note: Separate budgets; neither is drawn from the field store.

store_budget_rederivation.rationale: The ceiling is a declared cap, the observed worst case is 43.8% of it with a 2.28x margin and no eviction has ever been observed, the resident time window adds members rather than replacing them, and lowering the cap would trade against an unmeasured workload (a longer resident time horizon, a larger view, a source set beyond the recorded 22) that no recorded run covers.
